summary.text: Jim Avery is the Republican candidate for Missouri State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jeff Abney.
He previously served in the Missouri House of Representatives, representing District 95 from 2003 to 2009.

paragraphs.text: Jim Avery served in the United States Marine Corps from 1991 to 1995, including in Operation Restore Hope in Somalia.
He later joined the Missouri Army National Guard, deploying to Iraq in 2003 and to Afghanistan in 2009.
Avery was a member of the Missouri House of Representatives from 2003 to 2009 and earned a J.D. from Saint Louis University School of Law in 2017.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the State Senate on August 4, 2026.
